messages.text: How long is the warranty on the Harlo B30?

I don't want to give you a number that turns out to be wrong — our published warranty terms are being reconciled right now, so I'm confirming the exact coverage for the B30 and a team member will follow up by email with it.

If your unit ever arrives faulty or dies on you, that goes through RMA: you fill the intake form, we send a return label, and processing takes up to 10 days after it reaches the warehouse. One thing to know up front — overclocked or modified units aren't covered.

Have you already ordered one, or are you deciding?
